title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Document Status and Originals Put into Circulation at Issue
content:
This page concerns one act only: the issue by which a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` record leaves the pre-issue status Approved and becomes an issued document, charged with its issuance fee. It ties the originals entered by that act to the status the record holds when the act is performed. A corrected set or a replacement set that goes out on a document which is already issued is a different act, with its own rules on originals, and is not governed by this page.

## Rule

1. **Status examined.** For this issuing act, the status examined is the record's own status as it stands at the moment the act is performed.
2. **Approved record.** The act puts originals into circulation only when that status is Approved, the pre-issue status a draft reaches once the shipper has signed it off or it has been deemed signed off.
3. **Any other status.** If the record presented to this issuing act is in any other status (draft, issued, surrendered, released, accomplished or voided), the number of originals entered by the act is zero.

## Status table for this issuing act

| Status of the record when the act is performed | Originals entered by the act |
|---|---|
| Approved | Yes, subject to the other conditions of issue |
| Draft | None |
| Issued, surrendered, released or accomplished | None |
| Voided | None |

## Point of judgement

**The shipper has not answered the draft and the deemed-approval period is still running. Would this issuing act enter any originals for the record?** None. The record is still a draft, not Approved.
